messages:
Olivia (product): quick async check — we need to close the stagegate checklist for the next Dedicated capacity slate. pulling owners for procurement, racks, network, canary, and SRE signoff. can owners confirm status and blockers?

Jordan (eng-infra): procurement update — vendor confirmed H100 batch shipped but stuck in customs clearance. current ETA 3/25. no serials yet for reservation.

Maya (eng-platform): noted. we need placeholder SKU/IDs so platform can reserve capacity in the allocator and wire up routing rules. Jordan can you share any tentative skus or shipping IDs as soon as available?

Jordan (eng-infra): will share once customs releases. pushing vendor for export docs now. if customs delays extend we'll need to swap to fallback SKUs (A100) — need signoff from product on performance tradeoffs.

Sam (eng-runtime): for canary we only need 2 nodes with KV cache enabled. if we have to use A100 fallback we can still run canary but throughput will be ~20% lower. @Olivia any objections to fallback?

Olivia (product): fallback acceptable for canary only, not for full capacity commit. customers expecting <20ms p50 on some routes; make sure canary tests include latency gates.

Priya (eng-infra): rack update — physical space confirmed, but PDUs arriving late (vendor pushed by 6 days). power QA window now Friday AM. if PDUs delay further we might have to reschedule power-on.

Lee (eng-sre): planning power + network smoke on Friday 09:00 PT. need BMC credentials and remote KVM access added to infra-ops group before then. Priya can you add?

Priya (eng-infra): will add infra-ops to BMC ACLs by EOD Thursday.

Diego (netops): firewall / region egress rules — we need the VIP ranges for the dedicated subnet. Maya, can you publish the reservation CIDR to the infra-allocator doc? I'll open the firewall PR once I have the CIDR.

Maya (eng-platform): CIDR posted: 10.240.56.0/22 in the reservation doc (links in #eng-platform-docs). Diego — ping me if you want me to attach the exact route table snippet.

Diego (netops): thanks — opening PR now. expect review 2-3 hours.

Nate (sales): FYI one enterprise customer asked to be in the first wave. they need 2 reserved units and two-week notice. do we have a calendar to confirm slots?

Maya (eng-platform): calendar and reservation sheet updated. slot holds are provisional until we get finalized serials from Jordan. added a note to the sheet for Nate's customer.

Jordan (eng-infra): vendor just sent partial manifest — attaching here:
```
H100-serials: pending
A100-serials: US-2026-0452, US-2026-0453
ETA H100: 2026-03-25 (pending customs)
```

Olivia (product): thanks. action items so far: Jordan = procurement follow-up + serials; Priya = PDUs + BMC ACLs; Diego = firewall PR; Maya = CIDR + reservation holds; Sam = canary test plan + latency gates; Lee = power+smoke schedule. I assigned owners in the sheet.

Sam (eng-runtime): pinging @deploy-bot to schedule canary job once nodes are live.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary-run job 2026-03-27T16:00:00Z on placeholder nodes (if available).

Lee (eng-sre): quick ask — can owners please add expected ready-by dates to the sheet so I can book oncall for the smoke window?

Maya (eng-platform): added tentative ready-by dates with source notes (procurement ETA for H100, fallback A100 ready earlier).

Jordan (eng-infra): update 2 — customs released one pallet, vendor sending UPS manifest now. I'll DM serials and update the reservation sheet.

Olivia (product): perfect. if any owner hits a blocker that affects the milestone we escalate to PM sync. otherwise we'll close stagegate when SRE smoke passes and serials are in the allocator. :thumbsup:
